name: Bramble & Bee
tagline: A berry patch and apiary where the rows hum all summer long.
imageAlt: A close-up mix of fresh summer berries
description: Bramble & Bee began as four rows of strawberries and twelve hives. Today the patch runs on the same idea: keep the bees happy and the berries take care of themselves.
It’s a U-pick first and foremost — bring a flat and a sun hat. The wildflower honey is pulled twice a season and sells out within days of the summer harvest.
